body:
> I haven't tried it yet, but what about creating an InstantSearchManager (directly from createInstantSearchManager), perform a search on it, and inject it to an InstantSearch widget?

That's already the purpose of the JS Helper. I am open to discussion and ideas on how to move forward with the stack but I would prefer not to create yet another abstraction. React-instantsearch is pretty hard to grasp already and I think we should move towards less mechanics than more.

That's my 2cts and I'm open to discussing based on prototypes :)
